reason: A web frontend theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that applies ocean-themed colors, animated fish and bubbles, branding changes, and interactive mascot elements; the README also documents CLI installation and optional asset retrieval.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页前端提供海洋风格配色、动画装饰、品牌替换和可互动吉祥物元素的主题插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness web frontend theme plugin that adds ocean-inspired colors, animated decorations, branding changes, and interactive mascot elements.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness web interface styling and layout
Adds decorative animations, imagery, branding, and interactive mascot elements
Installs the plugin through the dsh CLI and may fetch optional image assets during installation
